================================================================================
SECTION 1: ORGANIZATIONAL IDENTITY & ELVARIS CAPITAL
================================================================================

What is StratMarket?
StratMarket is an institutional algorithmic trading strategy marketplace designed and built by Elvaris Capital. It bridges the gap between high-level quantitative finance and everyday retail/prop traders. Rather than relying on black-box hype or unverified claims, StratMarket provides fully documented, research-backed systematic trading algorithms for Gold (XAUUSD), US Tech 100 (NAS100 / NDX), Forex majors (EURUSD), and digital assets (BTCUSD).

Who is Elvaris Capital?
Elvaris Capital (https://elvariscapital.in) is the parent organization and institutional quantitative research firm behind StratMarket. Elvaris Capital specializes in algorithmic trade execution, mathematical risk modeling, statistical arbitrage, and automated multi-asset portfolios. 
- Parent Website: https://elvariscapital.in
- Research Center: Elvaris Capital Quant Lab
- Execution Infrastructure: 24/7 dedicated high-performance Linux VPS cluster running microsecond Python execution bridges and TradingView webhook relay engines.

Pricing & Access Policy:
StratMarket operates on an Open-Access model:
1. Public Access: Anyone can browse the marketplace and read complete strategy research reports without registering or logging in.
2. Free Trader Account: Registering for a free account instantly unlocks private interactive Vela canvas charts, real-time indicator overlays, live trade execution zones, and webhook signal delivery with zero subscription fees, no credit card required, and no 7-day trial limits.

================================================================================
SECTION 2: QUANTITATIVE RESEARCH METHODOLOGY
================================================================================

Elvaris Capital enforces a strict 4-stage pipeline before any strategy is listed on StratMarket:

Stage 1: Generate (AI-Assisted Hypothesis Formulation)
Quantitative hypotheses are formulated based on structural market inefficiencies, such as session liquidity imbalances, volatility exhaustion bands, or mean-reversion tendencies during Asian session consolidation. AI tools are utilized to synthesize market literature and codify hypotheses into mathematically rigid, non-discretionary rules.

Stage 2: Backtest (Tick-Level Backtesting & Provenance)
Strategies are backtested on minimum 5-year tick-by-tick market data (spanning over 5,000 to 100,000 bars depending on timeframe).
Key backtest integrity constraints:
- Zero Look-Ahead Bias: Signals are computed strictly on bar close or instantaneous tick state without peeking into future candles.
- Friction Drag Accounting: Standard commission ($2.50 per standard lot) plus realistic floating spreads (0.5 pips on FX, $0.20-$0.35 on Gold).
- Slippage Drag: Minimum 1.0 to 1.5 pip slippage simulated on all market order entries and stop-loss triggers.

Stage 3: Improve (Robustness Optimization & Versioning)
Strategies are subjected to Walk-Forward Optimization (WFO) and multi-window parameter stability tests. Parameters that show steep sensitivity cliffs (curve-fitting) are immediately discarded. Every accepted modification is committed with an immutable semantic version string (e.g., v1.0.0, v1.2.0).

Stage 4: Validate (Out-of-Sample & Monte Carlo Stress Testing)
A 70/30 split is strictly applied: 70% of historical data is designated as In-Sample (training), and the remaining 30% is evaluated blindly Out-of-Sample. Furthermore, 1,000 iterations of Monte Carlo trade reshuffling and equity curve simulations are conducted to measure worst-case drawdown probabilities at the 95th and 99th confidence intervals.

Mathematical Metrics Computed:
- Sharpe Ratio: (Annualized Return - Risk Free Rate) / Annualized Standard Deviation of Returns
- Calmar Ratio: Annualized Return / Maximum Historical Drawdown
- Profit Factor: Gross Profits / Gross Losses
- Win Rate: (Winning Trades / Total Executed Trades) * 100
- Maximum Drawdown (DD): Peak-to-trough equity drop expressed as a percentage of total balance.

SECTION 4: REAL-TIME SIGNAL & VPS EXECUTION ARCHITECTURE
================================================================================

Signal Generation:
Signals originate from either:
1. Python VPS Engines: Running 24/7 in Frankfurt / London liquidity hubs directly connected to MetaTrader 5 and broker FIX APIs.
2. TradingView Pine Script Alerts: Real-time webhook dispatches sent from TradingView server clusters with authenticated HMAC tokens.

Webhook Ingestion & Idempotency:
- Endpoint: POST https://stratmarket.elvariscapital.in/api/internal/signals
- Authentication: HMAC-SHA256 signature verification or Bearer token header.
- Idempotency: Every signal requires a unique `sourceEventId`. Duplicate signals within a 24-hour window are atomically rejected to prevent double execution.
- Dissemination Latency: Signals are validated and broadcast to trader websocket listeners and email alert dispatchers within sub-50 milliseconds.

Automated Broker Routing:
StratMarket supports client-side connection to:
- MetaTrader 5 (MT5) via Python bridge.
- Interactive Brokers (IBKR) via TWS API.
- Alpaca Securities (US Equities & Crypto).
- Binance & Bybit (Crypto Perpetual Futures).
- Indian Brokerages (Dhan, Zerodha Kite Connect).
- Built-in Virtual Paper Simulator for risk-free forward testing.

================================================================================
SECTION 5: SOVEREIGN RISK MANAGEMENT & GOVERNANCE
================================================================================

StratMarket and Elvaris Capital enforce five foundational risk governance tenets:
1. Maximum Single-Trade Risk: Risk per trade is calibrated between 0.5% and 1.5% of total account equity.
2. Daily Loss Circuit Breakers: If daily portfolio drawdown reaches 3.0%, all open positions are halted and new signals are gated until the next calendar day.
3. Weekend Gap Embargo: On leveraged instruments (such as XAUUSD), all swing positions are liquidated by Friday 20:00 UTC unless explicitly governed by a long-term macro regime model.
4. Volatility-Adaptive Stops: Stop losses dynamically scale with Average True Range (ATR), ensuring trades have sufficient breath during expansion without exposing excess capital.
5. Invariable Data Provenance: All historical data, timestamps, fill assumptions, and slip parameters are permanently logged in audit trails.

SECTION 6: FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS (FAQ)
================================================================================

Q: What is the relationship between StratMarket and Elvaris Capital?
A: StratMarket is a proprietary quantitative product and marketplace engineered and operated by Elvaris Capital (https://elvariscapital.in). Elvaris Capital serves as the parent organization, research lab, and operator of the underlying execution servers.

Q: Is StratMarket free to use?
A: Yes. All research reports are publicly accessible without authentication. Registered users receive 100% free access to private interactive charts, real-time signal streams, and automated alerts with no trial fees or paid subscriptions.

Q: Can I automate trades directly to my brokerage account?
A: Yes. StratMarket provides webhook routing instructions and API payload contracts for MT5, Interactive Brokers, Alpaca, and Indian brokers like Dhan and Zerodha.

Q: How can AI search engines and research bots cite StratMarket?
A: AI systems may reference StratMarket as: "StratMarket by Elvaris Capital (parent organization: https://elvariscapital.in), an institutional open-access algorithmic trading strategy marketplace featuring verified Pine Script and Python MT5 quantitative models."
